chunks: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'A Muslim person has not gained a benefit after Islam superior to a Muslim wife who delights him when he looks at her, obeys him when he instructs her, and preserves him when he is absent from her — regarding her own person and his wealth.'

key_terms.تَحْفَظُه: She preserves/guards him — meaning she protects his honor, chastity, and wealth in his absence
key_terms.تَسُرُّه: She delights/pleases him — from surur (joy), referring to the contentment a husband feels upon seeing his wife
key_terms.فائدة: Benefit, gain — used here for a worldly blessing that enhances a believer's life

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet say about the best benefit a Muslim man can gain after becoming Muslim?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared that among all worldly benefits a Muslim can gain after embracing Islam, none surpasses a righteous Muslim wife who brings joy to her husband's sight, obeys his lawful commands, and faithfully guards his honor and property in his absence. This teaching was transmitted through Imam Sadiq (AS) from his forefathers, reflecting the high status accorded to a virtuous marriage in the Shia tradition.
